item.text: The packet has 59 items in three query families. The duplicate relationship tables contain the same links. I also found some clause links with releases that differ from the document’s target, so the queries will match releases explicitly and use numeric TSG meeting order for earlier-pack comparisons.

import json,re,sqlite3,time,collections
packet=json.load(open('packet.json'))
con=sqlite3.connect('file:database.sqlite?mode=ro',uri=True)

def lit(s):
 return \"'\"+s.replace(\"'\",\"''\")+\"'\"

def pack_target(pack,releases):
 return f\"\"\"WITH target_clauses AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.id AS section_id,
           s.spec AS specification, s.clause AS clause,
           s.release AS target_release, p.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM cr_pack AS p
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.pack_id = p.id
    JOIN document AS d ON d.id = ip.cr
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS ms ON ms.cr = d.id
    JOIN section AS s ON s.id = ms.section_id AND s.release = d.target_release
    WHERE p.pack_number = {lit(pack)}
      AND d.target_release IN ({', '.join(map(lit,releases))})
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disposition AS v
          JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
          JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
          WHERE v.target = d.id
            AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
            AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
            AND m.wg = 'RAN4'
      )
)\"\"\"

history=\"\"\"earlier_packs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT t.section_id AS section_id,
           t.specification AS specification, t.clause AS clause,
           hp.pack_number AS cr_pack, hp.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting,
           hp.tsg_number AS tsg_number
    FROM target_clauses AS t
    JOIN cr_modifies_section AS hm ON hm.section_id = t.section_id
    JOIN document AS hd ON hd.id = hm.cr AND hd.target_release = t.target_release
    JOIN cr_in_pack AS hip ON hip.cr = hd.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS hp ON hp.id = hip.pack_id
    WHERE hp.tsg_number < t.tsg_number
)\"\"\"

out=[]
counts=collections.Counter()
start=time.monotonic()
for item in packet['items']:
 q=item['question']
 fields=item['fields']
 if q.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack '):
  pack=re.search(r'CR pack (RP-\\d+)',q).group(1)
  releases=list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'Rel-\\d+',q)))
  base=pack_target(pack,releases)
  if 'Keep the clauses that the pack changes first:' in q:
   family='first_pack'
   sql=base+\",\\n\"+history+\"\"\"
SELECT DISTINCT t.document AS document,
       t.specification AS specification, t.clause AS clause
FROM target_clauses AS t
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM earlier_packs AS e
    WHERE e.section_id = t.section_id
)\"\"\"
  elif 'every CR pack of the latest earlier TSG RAN meeting' in q:
   family='latest_earlier_pack'
   sql=base+\",\\n\"+history+\"\"\"
SELECT DISTINCT e.specification AS specification, e.clause AS clause,
       e.cr_pack AS cr_pack, e.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM earlier_packs AS e
WHERE e.tsg_number = (
    SELECT MAX(e2.tsg_number)
    FROM earlier_packs AS e2
    WHERE e2.section_id = e.section_id
)\"\"\"
  else:
   raise ValueError('Unrecognized pack question '+item['id'])
 else:
  match=re.search(r'"'^Change request (R4-'"\\d+) .*? targets (Rel-\\d+)\\.',q)
  assert match,item['id']
  seed,release=match.groups()
  family='shared_clause_peers'
  sql=f\"\"\"SELECT DISTINCT s.clause AS clause, d.number AS document,
       v.code AS disposition, m.label AS wg_meeting, p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM document AS seed
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS sm ON sm.cr = seed.id
JOIN section AS s ON s.id = sm.section_id AND s.release = seed.target_release
JOIN cr_modifies_section AS dm ON dm.section_id = s.id
JOIN document AS d ON d.id = dm.cr AND d.target_release = s.release AND d.id <> seed.id
JOIN disposition AS v ON v.target = d.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = v.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
JOIN cr_in_pack AS ip ON ip.cr = d.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = ip.pack_id
WHERE seed.number = {lit(seed)}
  AND seed.target_release = {lit(release)}
  AND v.evidence_status = 'source_verified'
  AND v.scope = 'whole_target'
  AND m.wg = 'RAN4'\"\"\"
 cur=con.execute(sql)
 assert [x[0] for x in cur.description] == fields,(item['id'],cur.description,fields)
 rows=cur.fetchall()
 assert len(rows)==len(set(rows)),item['id']
 counts[family]+=1
 print(item['id'],family,'rows',len(rows),flush=True)
 out.append({'id':item['id'],'sql':sql})
with open('queries.jsonl','w') as f:
 for entry in out:
  f.write(json.dumps(entry,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n')
print('WROTE',len(out),'FAMILIES',dict(counts),'SECONDS',round(time.monotonic()-start,2),flush=True)
PY"
